objective: HUD quick wins (SHANNON, 2026-11-24): teammates' pills with their health and the boon vote's ring and dots, sorting in Animals, messages under the notes, the hatch reveal scaled by rarity.
acceptance_criteria: In a shared fight each teammate has a pill top left: avatar, name, their team's health
The boon vote shows a 7-second ring and each player's avatar dot on the card they voted for
Animals sorts by power, rarity, level or newest with one button, remembered between visits
Messages always stack below the notes top right (egg ready, mates) and move down when a note appears
A common or uncommon hatch is a quick pop; rare and up the full moment (rays, a bigger card, the odds line, 'Add to my team' / 'Keep in the barn'); mythic and up shake the screen
verification: Part one, Studio 2026-11-25, build dev (local): a message stacked under the Meadow Egg note; a common hatch a 140 px pop with no rays, gone in 1.7 s; a mythic hatch the full reveal (rays, MYTHIC!!!) with the screen shake; the Animals header's Sort button. Lune 819/819, selene clean. Part two (teammate pills, the vote's ring and dots) is next.
